summary: SLLM_NVFP4_W4A4_FORCE_BASELINE=1 cannot run the Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 prefill. The failure is not an interaction with the projection-pack optimisation: it is the NVFP4 W4A4 baseline matmul itself.

experiments.note: normal path, used for every measurement in this line of work

experiments.error: Qwen node layer.0.mlp_gate_matmul.qwen38_projection_pack2 failed: backend status 260: matmul kernel launch: invalid configuration argument

experiments.note: the unpacked projection path exists and works; packing is default-on via default_on_env and can be disabled with =0

experiments.error: Qwen node layer.0.mlp_gate_matmul failed: backend status 260: matmul kernel launch: invalid configuration argument
experiments.note: label no longer carries .qwen38_projection_pack2, so the packed node is not the cause

attribution: The NVFP4 W4A4 baseline uses TilePolicy::Elementwise (one thread per output element). The Qwen3.8 MLP gate prefill is m=2048 x n=17408 = 35,651,584 outputs. The specialised prefill kernels were validated at that scale; the baseline launch configuration was not.
documented_rollback_claims_affected: phase82-default-adoption-scope.md: NVFP4 activation quantizer wave8 -> SLLM_NVFP4_FORCE_BASELINE=1 or SLLM_NVFP4_W4A4_FORCE_BASELINE=1
phase78-nvfp4-cross-model-measurement.md: prefill ID59 / decode ID58 -> SLLM_NVFP4_W4A4_FORCE_BASELINE=1 で旧ID11へ戻せる
validation_gap: Phase82 recorded force-baseline as PASS over 26 operator fixtures and 5 modes. Those are operator-scale fixtures, not the Qwen3.8 full-model graph at prefill shapes.
not_established: whether decode-only (m=1) force-baseline works; the run fails during prefill before reaching decode
whether the other FORCE_BASELINE flags (attention, matmul, FP8 outer) have the same gap
the exact launch parameter that HIP rejects
severity: Production default path is unaffected and fails closed: the error is raised at layer 0 with current_bytes=0, retryable_cleanup=0, durable_quarantine=0 on both targets. The impact is on rollback capability and on numerical debugging, not on shipped inference.

follow_up_2026_09_17.state: resolved within documented diagnostic T2 scope; both exact-target full-model NVFP4 runs passed
follow_up_2026_09_17.attribution_correction: The baseline uses one 256-thread block per output, not one thread. The per-X global-thread limit rejects 16,777,216 or more such blocks despite the reported maxGridSize[0].
follow_up_2026_09_17.repair: Split baseline launches at 16,777,215 outputs without changing arithmetic, graph, or chunk size; reject unsupported diagnostic scope explicitly.

resolved_unknowns.decode: Initial short NVFP4 reference runs succeeded on both targets.
resolved_unknowns.other_flags: All 11 flags inventoried; gfx1030 FP8 decode also failed Graph admission and was repaired separately.
resolved_unknowns.launch_parameter: Per-X total threads: grid blocks multiplied by 256 must be below 2^32.
